subject: LONDON SEWERS
text: London Sewers map layout connects Room 1 through Room 13, with Room 12 containing Boss Zoda's Blob and Room 13 leading to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR LONDON SEWERS
    1 = Starting Point for London Sewers
    12 = BOSS: Zoda's Blob
    13 = Leads to Overworld

subject: ROOM #1
text: From ROOM #1, head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

subject: ROOM #2
text: In ROOM #2, hop on the log raft and go to the tile in the upper right part of the room to activate a question mark that opens the door North to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    No enemies here just a log raft floating back and forth. Hop on the 
    raft and go to the tile in the upper right part of the room. This 
    will activate the question mark which once you grab opens the door 
    to the North and ROOM #3.

subject: ROOM #3
text: In ROOM #3 with five yellow jellyfish, hop over the water to the right and either take the passage North to ROOM #4 or jump back left to take the passageway North to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    This room has five yellow jellyfish. You can defeat them if you 
    want, but either way hop over the water to the right and then either 
    take the passage to the North to ROOM #4 or jump back to the left to 
    take the passageway to the North to ROOM #5.

subject: ROOM #4
text: In ROOM #4, defeat all three rats and three blue blobs to open a room to the West taking you to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There are three rats and three blue blobs in this room. Defeat all 
    of them and a room will open to the West taking you to ROOM #5.

subject: ROOM #5
text: In ROOM #5, activate the tile on the upper left part of the room and get the question mark to open the wall North leading to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has four red frogs hopping around. You don't have to 
    defeat them but it will help you reach the tile on the upper left 
    part of the room. Once you activate it and get the question
    mark the wall to the North will open leading you to ROOM #6.

subject: ROOM #6
text: In ROOM #6, defeat the two large rats to cause the North wall to open to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are two large rats in this room. Defeating them causes the 
    North wall to open to ROOM #7.

subject: ROOM #7
text: In ROOM #7, grab the medicine, then retrace your steps to ROOM #6, ROOM #5, and South to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There is nothing here but a medicine. Grab it and retrace your 
    steps to ROOM #6, then ROOM #5 and then South from ROOM #5 to 
    ROOM #3.

subject: ROOM #3 (Revisited)
text: When revisiting ROOM #3, hop on one of the tiles to your right to reveal the question mark which opens the gate West to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3 (Revisited):
    When you first enter you will notice some tiles to your right. Hop 
    on one of them to reveal the question mark which when you grab 
    will open the gate to the West and ROOM #8.

subject: ROOM #8
text: In ROOM #8, follow the path back and forth between ROOM #8 and ROOM #9 with three small rats until reaching the door that goes West to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    This room has three small rats. You will follow a path between this 
    room and ROOM #9 that goes back and forth until you eventually end 
    up in this room again and a door that goes West to ROOM #10.

subject: ROOM #9
text: In ROOM #9, avoid or defeat the rats as you follow the path that goes back and forth between ROOM #8 and ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    As stated above you need to avoid the rats in this room and ROOM #8 
    as you go along the path that goes back and forth between these two 
    rooms. You can of course defeat them if you wish.

subject: ROOM #10
text: In ROOM #10, defeat the two jellyfish and two red frogs on the 4 paths with conveyor tiles to open the wall North to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    In this room are two jellyfish and two red frogs. There are also 4 
    paths with conveyor tiles on each path in different directions. 
    Defeat all the enemies in this room to open the wall to the North 
    and ROOM #11. Remember that these conveyor tiles can push you off 
    the path into the water.

subject: ROOM #11
text: In ROOM #11, defeat the three owls to open the door North to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    This room has three owls in it. Defeat them and the door to the 
    North will open to ROOM #12.

subject: Zoda's Blob
text: In ROOM #12, defeat Zoda's Blob by continuously hopping around the ball without staying on one tile for too long, then jump on one of the tiles it was on to get the question mark opening the door East to ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12: BOSS: Zoda's Blob
    Inside of this room is Zoda. He creates some sort of weird ball. 
    Just hop around the ball until you defeat it. Don't sit on one
    tile for two long. You must keep moving to defeat this blob. Then 
    jump on one of the tiles that it was on to get the question mark 
    which opens the door to the East and ROOM #13.

subject: ROOM #13
text: ROOM #13 exits back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    Exit back to the overworld.

subject: LONDON SEWERS 2
text: London Sewers 2 map layout connects Room 1 through Room 22, with Room 21 featuring Boss Zoda X and Room 22 leading to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR LONDON SEWERS 2
    1 = Starting Point for London Sewers 2
    21 = BOSS: Zoda X
    22 = Leads to Overworld

subject: ROOM #1
text: In ROOM #1, there are two hearts to the left and two pairs of two hearts to the right if you jump on the tiles that way, otherwise head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    There are two hearts if you need them to the left. There are also 
    two more pairs of two hearts to the right if you jump on the tiles 
    that way. Otherwise head North to ROOM #2.

subject: spiked frisbees
text: In ROOM #2, defeat the three Zoda spawns and jump on the tile to open the chest to obtain spiked frisbees, then head West to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three Zoda spawns in this room. Defeat them and jump on 
    the tile to open the chest to obtain spiked frisbees. After 
    acquiring this head to the West and ROOM #3.

subject: ROOM #3
text: In ROOM #3, defeat the two large rats to open the door South to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    Just two large rats in here. Defeat them to open the door to the 
    South and ROOM #4.

subject: ROOM #4
text: In ROOM #4, defeating the two owls opens the wall South to ROOM #5, and a tile opens the door West to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    This room has two small rats and two owls. When you defeat the owls 
    the wall to the South will open revealing ROOM #5. There is also a 
    tile in this room that will open the door to the West and ROOM #6.

subject: medicine
text: In ROOM #5, jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest containing medicine, then head back to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    Jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has 
    medicine inside. Collect this and then head back to ROOM #4.

subject: ROOM #6
text: In ROOM #6, keep heading left across carefully timed jumps to reach the exit South to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    This room has no enemies but a lot of carefully timed jumps. Keep 
    heading to the left and eventually you will see an exit to the 
    South and ROOM #7.

subject: ROOM #7
text: In ROOM #7, defeat the two caterpillars to open the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There are two caterpillars in here that once defeated will open the 
    door South to ROOM #8.

subject: ROOM #8
text: In ROOM #8, dispose of the four blue blobs to open the door East to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four blue blobs in this room. Dispose of them and the 
    door to the East will open to ROOM #9.

subject: ROOM #9
text: In ROOM #9, activate the mark on the tile in the middle group to open the wall South to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are three sets of tiles. Look for the tile in the middle 
    group to activate a mark. Grab the mark and the wall to the South 
    will open to ROOM #10.

subject: medicine
text: In ROOM #10, jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has medicine inside, then head back to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    Jump on the tile on the left side to open the chest which has 
    medicine inside. Collect this and then head back to ROOM #9.

subject: ROOM #9: (Revisited)
text: In ROOM #9 (Revisited), fall through the floor in the middle of one of the tiles to drop down to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9: (Revisited):
    You will need to fall through the floor in the middle of one of 
    these tiles. This will allow you to fall to ROOM #11.

subject: ROOM #11
text: In ROOM #11, head North to ROOM #12, or take the West path to ROOM #13 from the left path, the East path to ROOM #14 from the right path, or the South path to ROOM #16 from the middle path.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    In this room are three vertical rows. You can head North to ROOM 
    #12. If you landed on the left path you can also take the path West 
    to ROOM #13. If you landed on the right path you can also take the 
    path East to ROOM #14. If you landed on the middle path you can 
    also take the path South to ROOM #16.

subject: ROOM #12
text: In ROOM #12, each path ends in a ladder to the North that takes you upstairs to ROOM #15.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Each path ends in a ladder to the North. If you take any of these 
    ladders they will take you back upstairs to ROOM #15.

subject: ROOM #13
text: In ROOM #13, defeat all Zoda spawns, collect two hearts, and locate the mark to open the door East back to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    If you can't tell by the pattern of the tiles (the pattern is a 
    skull) that this is a dead end. After you defeat all the Zoda spawns 
    you can grab two hearts and eventually you should also find the mark 
    to open the door to the East back to ROOM #11.

subject: ROOM #14
text: In ROOM #14, defeat the three Zoda spawns, jump across the water to defeat the blue blob, and take the path South to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    This room has three Zoda spawns and one blue blob on the other side 
    of the water. After defeating the spawns you need to jump across and 
    defeat the blob. Then take the path South to ROOM #17.

subject: ROOM #15
text: In ROOM #15, find a tile to open the wall South taking you back to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    There are four blue blobs hopping around in this room. Dispose of 
    the if you wish and look for a tile to open the wall to the South 
    taking you back to ROOM #9.

subject: ROOM #16
text: In ROOM #16, defeat the five small rats to open the wall East to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    There are five small rats. Defeat them and the wall will open to 
    East and ROOM #17.

subject: ROOM #17
text: In ROOM #17, defeat the two caterpillars to open the door South to ROOM #18.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17:
    Two caterpillars are in here and once defeated the door to the 
    South open to ROOM #18.

subject: spiked frisbees
text: In ROOM #18, jump between rafts to find two hearts, spiked frisbees, and a life sign, then find the exit South to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18:
    You need to jump from raft to raft here. There are also two hearts 
    and some more spiked frisbees in here. You can also get the life 
    sign if you feel lucky. Once you make it around the rafts you should 
    see an exit to the South and ROOM #19.

subject: ROOM #19
text: In ROOM #19, defeat the four Zoda spawns to open the wall East to ROOM #20, and activate the switch to open the door West to boss ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    There are four Zoda spawns in here. Defeat them and then the wall 
    to the East will open to ROOM #20. You can also activate the switch 
    to open the door to the West and ROOM #21 but this is where the BOSS 
    is so do ROOM #20 first.

subject: medicine
text: In ROOM #20, get the medicine and head back West to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20:
    There is a medicine in here. Get it and then head back West to ROOM 
    #19 avoiding enemies or defeating them as necessary.

subject: Zoda X
text: In ROOM #21, avoid Zoda X's spread of shots and ring of fire while navigating conveyor belts, hitting him when visible to defeat him and unlock the door North to ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21: BOSS: Zoda X

    This Zoda boss is harder than most bosses. The room is full of
    conveyor belts going in multiple directions so you will have trouble
    walking in a straight line. Zoda X will appear in random locations
    and either shoot a spread of shots or make a ring of fire. Avoid
    both the shots and the fire as best as possible and just keep 
    trying to hit him when he becomes visible and eventually he'll go 
    down. Defeat him and take the door to the North ROOM #22.

subject: ROOM #22
text: ROOM #22 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:
    This is the exit back to the overworld.

subject: tetrad
text: Back in the overworld, walk the sewers until you find another tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Back in the overworld you keep walking the sewers until you find 
    another tetrad.

subject: Mike
text: After speaking with Holmes, Mike says the magic words 'PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW' to flip the pages and travel to another time period.

evidence.quote:
Then take the ladder you'll find Holmes who deduces 
    that there must be a Zoda-Y and Zoda-Z as well. You thank Holmes for 
    his help and then say the magic words:
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW. 
    This flips the pages again and sends Mike to another time period.

subject: piano player
text: In the saloon in DESERT TOWN, talk to the piano player and pay attention to the tune he sings, as it will be used later in the chapter.

evidence.quote:
In the saloon you will want to talk to 
    the piano player. Pay attention to the tune he sings you will use 
    this tune later in this chapter.

subject: shopkeeper
text: In the shop in the Northern part of DESERT TOWN, talk to the shopkeeper who gives a clue about where to go next.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you go to the shop in 
    the Northern part of the town. He will give you a clue to where to 
    go next.

subject: dynamite
text: Go to Bob's store in DESERT TOWN and Bob will give you dynamite.

evidence.quote:
Make your way back to Bob's store and he will now give you 
    some dynamite.

subject: dynamite
text: Follow the line of lighter shade rocks towards the mountain ridge and lay dynamite there to open up caves containing gold and chicken nuggets.

evidence.quote:
You should see some rocks that are
    a lighter shade forming a line towards the ridge. Follow this line 
    and lay the dynamite there. This will open up caves that you can 
    find gold and chicken nuggets in.

subject: BIG HEART
text: Place dynamite between the two large boulders next to the ridge to reveal a cave door with a BIG HEART in it.

evidence.quote:
You will also see two large 
    boulders next to the ridge. Place a load of dynamite in between 
    these to reveal a cave door with a BIG HEART in it.

subject: gold piece
text: If you collect the gold piece, Bob at the store will offer to purchase it for points before it is lost at the start of the next chapter.

evidence.quote:
Go back and get 
    more dynamite and if you collected the gold piece Bob will offer to 
    purchase your gold. All it does is give you points so it is 
    completely optional if you want to sell it to him or not. I would
    recommend it however because otherwise you will lose that gold at
    the start of the next chapter.

subject: cave
text: Place dynamite a few spaces below the cave where you obtained the gold nugget to reveal the cave you need to enter next.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the ridge and place 
    dynamite a few spaces below the cave that you got the gold nugget. 
    This will reveal the cave you need to go next.

subject: MINING CAVE
text: Mining Cave map layout connects Room 1 through Room 13, with Room 12 containing Boss Mining Cyclops and Room 13 serving as the exit to overworld.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR MINING CAVE
    1 = Starting Point for Mining Cave
    12 = BOSS: Mining Cyclops
    13 = Exit to Overworld

subject: ROOM #1
text: From ROOM #1, head North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

subject: ROOM #2
text: In ROOM #2, defeat the three blue scorpions to head North to Room #3 or West to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three blue scorpions in here. Defeat them and head North 
    to Room #3 or West to ROOM #4.

subject: ROOM #3
text: In ROOM #3, defeat the two blue asps and head back to ROOM #2 and then ROOM #4 since the other side of the wall cannot be accessed yet.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    This room has two blue asps. After you defeat them you will notice 
    there is more to this room on the other side of the wall. Nothing 
    you can do now so head back to ROOM #2 and then ROOM #4.

subject: ROOM #4
text: In ROOM #4, defeat the two cactus guys and shoot the crack in the North wall to open the wall to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    This room has four tiles and two cactus guys. Defeat the cactus 
    guys and then shoot the crack in the wall to the North. This opens 
    the wall to ROOM #5.

subject: ROOM #5
text: ROOM #5 has a ladder going up to ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room simply has a ladder going up to ROOM #6.

subject: ROOM #6
text: In ROOM #6, jump back and forth between three horizontal paths to avoid rolling boulders and make your way East to ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    Inside of this room are three horizontal paths to the right. On 
    each of these paths is a rolling boulder. Just jump back and forth 
    between these paths to avoid the boulder make your way to the East 
    and eventually the door and ROOM #7.

subject: ROOM #7
text: In ROOM #7, jump to the floating tile in the middle of the tiles to fall through the false floor down to the other side of Room #3.

evidence.quote:
There is a floating tile in the middle of the tiles. If 
    you jump to this you will fall through the false floor down to the 
    other side of Room #3.

subject: ROOM #3 (revisited)
text: When falling into ROOM #3 from ROOM #7, defeat the two cactus guys to open the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3 (revisited):
    If you fell from ROOM #7 you will find two cactus guys which you 
    must defeat to open the door to the South and ROOM #8.

subject: ROOM #8
text: In ROOM #8, activate the tile on the South end to reveal a question mark that opens the door South to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are two blue asps and two blue scorpions in here. You don't 
    have to defeat them but it makes it much easier to activate the 
    tile on the South end of the room. This will reveal a question mark
    which after you get will open the door to the South to ROOM #9.

subject: slingshot
text: In ROOM #9, defeat the treasure chest enemies to open the wall South to ROOM #10, and optionally pick up the slingshot inside the normal treasure chest.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    This room has the treasure chest enemies. Defeat them to open the 
    wall to the South and ROOM #10. There is also a normal trasure 
    chest in here with a slingshot if you want to pick that up.

subject: ROOM #10
text: In ROOM #10, defeat the three cactus guys to open the wall South to ROOM #11, or take the passageway West to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    There are three cactus guys in this room who if you defeat will 
    open the wall to the South and ROOM #11. There is also a passageway 
    to the West and ROOM #12 but go to ROOM #11 first.

subject: medicine
text: In ROOM #11, open the chest to reveal a medicine, then head back North to ROOM #10 and West to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    In this room is just a chest and tiles. Open the chest to reveal a 
    medicine and then head back North to ROOM #10 and then West to ROOM 
    #12.

subject: Mining Cyclops
text: In ROOM #12, attack the Mining Cyclops while avoiding touching him, then jump across the floating platforms on the South side to reach ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12: BOSS: Mining Cyclops
    There is just a long straight pathway to a cyclops at the other end. 
    After awhile he will grab a rock to throw at you just keep hitting 
    him until he is defeated. Be careful not to touch him as he will kill 
    you instantly if you do. After you defeat him a floating platform 
    will appear on the South side of the room. Jump on this and then the 
    next and then to the corner of the room on the bottom left part of 
    the room. This will take you to ROOM #13.

subject: ROOM #13
text: ROOM #13 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    This is the exit back to the overworld.
